description: A Java class named OBD2C that processes automotive diagnostic data from a CSV file, bins data by RPM and load, and outputs processed data into a C file format. It includes methods for bin initialization, line processing, and value calculation.

classes.name: OBD2C
classes.description: Main class for processing OBD2 diagnostic data, creating bins for RPM and load, and aggregating values.

classes.name: OBD2C.Bucket
classes.description: Inner class to store multiple advance values for each RPM/load bin and compute their average.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, initializes data structures, loads data, and writes output.

methods.name: loadRpmBins
methods.description: Initializes RPM bins with evenly spaced values between 800 and 7000.

methods.name: fillLoadBins
methods.description: Initializes load bins with evenly spaced percentage values from 0 to 100.

methods.name: processLine
methods.description: Parses a CSV line, converts values, determines bins, and stores advance data.
